use: A clear, doable action request: build, fix, change, run, open, send, add. The default action ack.

Feedback, a complaint or a preference to keep, said with a little dry weight; nothing to answer.

Anything quick where User is waiting for an immediate result.
A request that needs several steps before an answer.
Look at the screen or something visible ("look at this", "what do you think of this").
Look at the screen or something visible; a shorter variation on Let me take a look.
Diagnose a problem: why something is broken, slow, wrong or failing.
Inspect a thing User points at or describes (a link, an idea, a tool, a repo).
Read a message, page, document or output User refers to.
Open or show something: a file, a thread, logs, a page, a past result.
Facts from outside: prices, docs, specs, news, availability.
An open question that needs research before any answer.
Clearly big work: a long build, a big research sweep, many files, a dataset.
Open design, planning or judgement questions ("how would we…", "what's the best way…").
A long ramble with several asks that ends in a request; Heimdall must untangle it first.
User hands over a task to be owned end to end, often with "handle it", "take care of it".
